title: Yardeni下调标普500年终目标至7500点
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You have lowered your forecast from $7,900 to $7,500 getting into the end of this year. Can you talk a little bit more about why you're doing that?
segments.zh: 你把年底预测从7900点下调至7500点。能多谈谈为什么这样做吗？

segments.en: Good morning. Well, I think it's clear that there's a lot of jitters about the AI trade.
segments.zh: 早上好。我认为很明显，市场对AI交易有很多紧张情绪。

segments.en: And I'm not sure that it's over. It's great to see that the futures market is rebounding strongly, but there are going to be investigations into Nvidia. There's going to be more concerns
segments.zh: 我不确定这已经结束。看到期货市场强劲反弹很好，但会有对英伟达的调查。还会有更多担忧

segments.en: about the viability of the AI build out. Our view has been that a slowing down of the AI
segments.zh: 关于AI建设可行性的担忧。我们的观点是，AI建设放缓

segments.en: build out is actually a bullish development. So while we're looking for a lower year end target,
segments.zh: 实际上是一个看涨的发展。所以虽然我们寻求较低的年底目标，

segments.en: we're still very bullish. We still think that this is a bull market. We think that what is going on here actually reduces the likelihood of having an AI bubble that bursts and takes the
segments.zh: 我们仍然非常看涨。我们仍认为这是牛市。我们认为这里发生的情况实际上降低了AI估值重估并拖累

segments.en: it takes the economy down. We think that the economy is going to remain remarkably resilient.
segments.zh: 经济下行的可能性。我们认为经济将保持惊人的韧性。

segments.en: It's we stood all sorts of stress tests. So, you know, we're just simply running out of time.
segments.zh: 我们经受住了各种压力测试。所以，你知道，我们只是时间不多了。

segments.en: I didn't know that we could make it to $7,900 by the end of the year, but $7,500 would still be an increase of around 10%. Not too bad. Not too shabby after three years of very strong earnings growth.
segments.zh: 我不知道我们能在年底达到7900点，但7500点仍将增长约10%。在三年强劲的盈利增长之后，还不错。不算太差。
